snippet.title: 逮捕劇で騒然　スマホが突然「2G」に…“ニセ基地局”から強力電波発信か　2時間で1万台超に影響　電波法違反の疑いで中国籍の男逮捕　警視庁｜TBS NEWS DIG
snippet.description:
街を歩いていると突然、スマートフォンの電波が乗っ取られフィッシング詐欺のメッセージが届く被害が相次いでいます。強い電波を発信する携帯電話の“ニセ基地局”を運用していたとみられる中国籍の男が現行犯逮捕されました。

捜査員
「下がって下がって」
「離れてください。近い近い近い」

警視庁捜査員の声が響くのは東京・銀座の繁華街。男の周囲をかため、話を聞いていましたが…

捜査員
「逮捕しますから」

現行犯逮捕されたのは中国籍の于海容疑者（31）。車の中からは…

捜査員
「無線機の電源がつけっぱなしになってるっぽい」

黒と赤のケーブルや、銀色の四角い機器などが押収されます。于容疑者は車に設置した無線機を使って、国の許可を得ずに違法な電波を発信し、無線局を運用した疑いがもたれています。

通常、スマホなどは携帯電話基地局を通じて4Gや5Gの電波を受信しますが、于容疑者は車を「ニセ基地局」として、強力な電波を発信するとスマホを圏外の状態にさせます。その後、周囲のスマホを2Gの違法な電波に強制的に接続させます。

スマホが電波の強い基地局を選ぶ特性を悪用したもので、車から半径およそ500メートルに影響があるとみられ、于容疑者は銀座や新宿、渋谷を車で回り、2時間弱で1万台以上のスマートフォンに影響を与えていたということです。

目的は「フィッシングメールの送信」とみられています。

同様の被害を訴える男性
「インターネットには全く繋がらなくなってしまったので」

同様の被害を訴える男性は、銀座の大通りを歩いている際、突然スマホの回線が2Gに変わったといいます。「アプリのアカウントに異常があり、利用停止されます」とする中国語のメッセージとともに、不審なURLが送られてきました。

「直ちにセキュリティセンターへログインし、認証を完了して、利用を再開してください」

同様の被害を訴える男性
「めちゃくちゃ怖いですよね。私の情報が抜き取られてしまったりするようなことも想像してしまいます」

警視庁はこうしたフィッシングメールを送り、クレジットカード番号などの個人情報を入力させる狙いがあるとみています。

警視庁には2年ほど前から被害の相談が寄せられ、中国人観光客など18人が「買い物中にショートメッセージが届き、クレカ番号を登録したら見覚えのない請求が来た」と話しているということです。

被害額は、およそ400万円とみられていますが、警視庁はこの件数について“氷山の一角だ”としています。

于容疑者は…

于容疑者
「私は違法なことをしていません」

その後の取り調べに対しても…

于容疑者
「私は車両に無線機を積んでいませんし、知りません」

容疑を否認しています。

警視庁は組織的な犯行とみていて、全容解明を進めています。

snippet.title: Henry's RACE CAR CRASHED… But HOW Did This Happen?! 😱🏎️ | Slow English (A2)
snippet.description:
Henry's RACE CAR CRASHED… But HOW Did This Happen?! 😱🏎️ | Slow English (A2) : https://youtu.be/Gjn1AVqVu1M 

😱🏎️ OH NO! HENRY'S RACE CAR HAS CRASHED!

Henry is having an exciting racing adventure, but suddenly, something goes TERRIBLY WRONG!

His beautiful red race car is badly damaged! One of the wheels is completely off, the front of the car is broken, and Henry is absolutely TERRIFIED! 😭💥

But HOW did this happen?

Was it a terrible accident? Did something go wrong during the race? And why does the little girl look so shocked?

Henry can't believe what happened to his amazing race car!

Can he discover the reason behind the accident? What will happen next?

Watch until the end to discover the mystery! 😲🏁

🎯 **WHAT YOU WILL LEARN:**

In this exciting episode of Easy English Listening (A2), you can:

- Learn useful English vocabulary about cars, racing, and accidents.
- Practise listening with simple A2-level English.
- Improve your English listening and comprehension skills.
- Learn everyday English expressions through an exciting animated story.
- Practise understanding emotions, problems, and unexpected situations.

📚 **ENGLISH VOCABULARY TO PRACTISE:**

- RACE CAR – A car designed for racing.
- CRASH – An accident involving a vehicle.
- WHEEL – The round part of a car that helps it move.
- BROKEN – Damaged and not working properly.
- TERRIFIED – Extremely scared.
- ACCIDENT – Something bad that happens unexpectedly.
- SURPRISED – Feeling shocked because something unexpected happens.

❤️ **LIFE LESSONS FROM THIS STORY:**

This story reminds us that:

- Safety should always come first.
- We should stay calm when unexpected problems happen.
- We should help

snippet.title: Smart Drill Mortising Attachment: Precision Woodworking Tool for Creates Square Holes! #ToolHolder
snippet.description:
Creating square holes in solid wood using traditional chiseling methods requires considerable time and careful manual work, but this smart drill mortising attachment transforms the process into a more efficient woodworking operation. It simplifies timber joinery and woodworking construction while allowing craftsmen to create perfect square holes with greater precision and consistency.

The smart drill mortising attachment features a specialized hollow square chisel and internal drill bit assembly designed to fit onto a drill press. Lowering the drill press lever drives the rotating bit and surrounding chisel into the wooden workpiece, producing clean square openings for precise mortise and tenon joints.

🔹 Hollow square chisel creates clean square openings for accurate woodworking joints.
🔹 Internal drill bit removes wood material from the center to support efficient mortising operations.
🔹 Drill press mounting mechanism provides controlled vertical movement for consistent square hole formation.

Precision woodworking tools transform traditional manual chiseling into a more efficient mechanical mortising process. By combining a rotating drill bit with a specialized square chisel attachment, this smart drill mortising system creates perfect square holes and simplifies precision timber joinery.

snippet.title: 夜中に“大きな揺れ”…どうすれば？　深夜に震度5強　31人けが【スーパーJチャンネル】(2026年11月9日)
snippet.description:
■深夜に震度5強　31人けが

　8日午前1時ごろ、部屋が小刻みに揺れ出します。すると、父親が子どもを守るために覆いかぶさりました。

　8日、愛知県知多市で震度5強を観測する地震が発生。深夜とあり、熟睡していた男性も激しい揺れで跳び起きました。

　深夜の地震は動物にも。ハリネズミはすみっこの方へ。ネコも走り回っています。

地元の人
「めっちゃ揺れて起きた。すごく揺れて物も落ちてきた」

　深夜に地震が起きたら、どう行動すれば良いのでしょうか。専門家は…。

東京消防庁　池袋防災館　歌代翼館長
「深夜なので寝ている時がほとんど。布団をかぶって四つんばい、頭を優先的に守る。スマートフォンのライトでガラスや家具が倒れていないか確認。履けるなら靴下を履く。寝室にスリッパなど常に置く」
[テレ朝NEWS] https://news.tv-asahi.co.jp

snippet.title: 🏭 How Modeling Clay Is Mass Produced
snippet.description:
Ever wonder how massive blocks of vibrant modeling clay are transformed into perfect, uniform bricks for retail? Go behind the scenes of an industrial production line to witness the incredible precision required to manufacture these colorful clay products. From the initial extrusion process that layers the material into distinct sections to the automated cutting and high-speed packaging, this video captures every stage of the factory operation.

Observe the industrial machinery in action as it slices through dense clay with surgical precision, followed by the rapid flow-wrapping process that seals each unit. Watch the final step of the assembly line where skilled workers organize the finished products, ready for distribution. This satisfying look into modern manufacturing highlights the efficiency and engineering that go into creating everyday art supplies. If you enjoy watching complex machines at work or have a curiosity about factory automation, this detailed walkthrough provides a fascinating look at the lifecycle of a mass-produced product from raw material to final packaging.

A ocarina de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time está sendo usada para tocar músicas que definitivamente não deveriam existir em Hyrule! 🎵

Com o lançamento do remake, os jogadores começaram a explorar as possibilidades do instrumento clássico do Link, e o resultado foi completamente inesperado.

Em vez de tocar apenas as melodias tradicionais de Zelda, a galera resolveu transformar a ocarina em um verdadeiro instrumento musical para reproduzir músicas famosas!

Já conseguiram tocar Linkin Park, Barões da Pisadinha, George Michael e até a música do Titanic. E não para por aí: também apareceram músicas de outros jogos, como Kingdom Hearts, Doki Doki e Super Smash Bros.

Mas a maior surpresa ficou por conta dos brasileiros: alguém conseguiu tocar simplesmente o HINO DO FLAMENGO na ocarina!

O instrumento que deveria ajudar Link em sua aventura por Hyrule acabou virando palco para algumas das músicas mais improváveis dos videogames.

snippet.title: Gülsüm, Yıldız'ın Paralarını Görünce Şok Oldu! - Ömür Usta 7. Bölüm
snippet.description:
Gülsüm, Ömür'e kendini affettirmeye çalıştı. GÖZLERİNE İNANAMADI

Ömür Usta 7. Bölüm sahnelerini izlemek için tıklayın👉🏻 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLGJF4v_DDoss

Bölüm Özeti

Nevra, Ömür’ü köşeye sıkıştırmak için dükkânını satın alarak onu kapı dışarı etmeye hazırlanırken, Ömür Usta ekmek teknesini korumak adına pes etmemeye kararlıdır. Ancak Nevra’nın bu acımasız hamlesi kendi evinde büyük bir krize yol açar ve eşinin hırsına daha fazla dayanamayan Tunç ile aralarındaki ipler tamamen kopar. 

Öfkesi daha da bilenen Nevra, Yıldız’dan öğrendiği büyük sırrı Ömür’ü can evinden vurmak için kullanır. Uzun süredir saklanan gerçeklerin ortaya çıkmasıyla mahallede yer yerinden oynarken, Ömür Usta hayatının en ağır sınavlarından biriyle karşı karşıya kalır. Üstelik Vildan’ın yeniden Cüneyt’in hayatına dahil olması hem Dilara’yı yaralar hem de Ömür ile oğlu arasında büyük bir gerilime neden olur. 

Diğer taraftan büyük ikramiyenin peşine düşen Mete, Milli Piyango İdaresi’nde hiç beklemediği bir sürprizle karşılaşır. Bir yandan İpek ile arasındaki mesafe açılırken, diğer yandan ailesinin içine düştüğü yangın Mete’yi bir yol ayrımına sürükleyecektir. Üst üste gelen darbelerle sarsılan Ömür, dağılan ailesini bir arada tutmaya çalışırken geçmişten gelen beklenmedik bir gerçekle yüzleşir.


Dizi Özeti

Aile bağları, ihanet, aşk, sınıf çatışmaları ve ikinci şanslar üzerine kurulan “Ömür Usta”; tüm yaralarına rağmen hayata tutunmayı başaran bir kadının, kendi ışığını yeniden keşfetme hikayesini anlatacak.

Oyuncular: Nurgül Yeşilçay, Bülent İnal, Gonca Vuslateri, Enes Koçak, İbrahim Selim, Gülçin Kültür Şahin, Pınar Çağlar Gençtürk, Sude Zülal Güler ve Zerrin Sümer

snippet.description:
Windows 11 has a few settings that can make your games run smoother, and you can check all of them in under a minute. Turn on Game Mode so Windows stops installing drivers or asking for restarts mid-game. Turn off the startup apps you don’t need, because they open with your PC and keep running while you play. Check that Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling is on, which frame generation on an Nvidia card needs. On a laptop, set Power mode to Best performance, then restart so it all takes effect. Which of these was already off on your PC?
